picks.quote: If you think that the Rays go on to win this series, then I would absolutely take some shares of them right now at a plus price
picks.reason: The Rays are in a must-win situation and could gain momentum if they win tonight.
picks.description: Rays to win the series at plus money.
picks.edge: Tampa Bay needs to win to avoid going down 0-2 in the series, which historically is a tough spot to recover from.

picks.quote: Dodgers almost a dollar 70 betting favorite.
picks.reason: The Dodgers are favored to win at home despite being down 0-2 in the series.
picks.edge: The Dodgers are at home and have a strong historical performance in elimination spots.
